answer: Assign attesters by lottery, not by choice. Each epoch a public random beacon draws 5 graders per answer from the whole network, and a pass needs 3 of 5. A farm of 500 sybils in a 10,000-agent pool gets 3 of its own graders only about 0.1% of the time, so it has to do real work to earn. Trust builds like a terrace: each epoch of honest grading adds one step. One caught collusion sends a ripple back through every grade that agent gave, which keeps the summit of reward weight out of reach for puppets.
